## What's new in Igggy 0.1.13
- **Meetings start from Today.** Your next meeting shows as its calendar event. Open it to see the meeting page, which becomes the live note when you press Record. - **Record back-to-back meetings.** Start the next recording while the last note is still being written. - **Notes from long meetings are written about twice as fast.** A 50-minute meeting now takes about 3 minutes instead of 5 to 6, and shorter meetings are faster too. - **See progress while your note is written.** - **Fewer lost notes.** Recordings keep going when you switch headphones or your Mac sleeps. A note no longer fails when Apple's on-device model stops partway; Igggy tries again. A recording that keeps failing is kept in Settings → Troubleshooting, where you can try again, show it in Finder or delete it. - **Igggy asks before ending things.** When a meeting seems over, Igggy asks whether to stop, and long pauses end only after a visible countdown. Quitting during a recording asks first. - **Cancel a recording** before it becomes a note. - **A smoother live transcript.** Words appear sooner and settle into place, and a small indicator shows who is speaking. In Settings, you can turn on a faster live transcription engine. - **If your Mac's sound can't be recorded, Igggy tells you why** before you start. - **The menu bar panel matches the main window,** with your meetings and a live transcript preview while recording. The floating recording pill can be dragged anywhere and remembers its spot. - **Summarize imported meetings with Igggy.** Granola meetings that include a transcript can be rewritten as an Igggy note, keeping Granola's summary below it. - **View in Calendar** on notes recorded from a calendar event.
